sources.entry: Cashew - Cashew macOS Github Issue Tracker.

summary.one_liner: OpenCashew is the open-sourced code for Cashew, a macOS app, which its maintainers have handed over for community bug fixes and features because they lack time to maintain it.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes the repository as the source for the Cashew macOS app, which is also distributed on the Mac App Store. It explains that the maintainers no longer have time to maintain the app and invite pull requests for bug fixes, new features, and refactors. The README says the project is roughly 50/50 Swift and Objective-C, with new code preferably in Swift. It gives setup steps: install Xcode, open Cashew.xcworkspace, and run. It also states that the project currently requires an upgrade to Swift 4 before it will build, and asks for a volunteer to do that first. The README does not describe the app's end-user features.
use_cases: Build and run the Cashew macOS app from source
Contribute bug fixes to a macOS Swift/Objective-C app
Study a mixed Swift and Objective-C macOS codebase
Help upgrade an Xcode project from Swift 4 era code
Find an open-source replacement or fork of Cashew
how_to_run: Install Xcode from the Mac App Store
Open the Cashew.xcworkspace file in Xcode
notable: Source for a shipped Mac App Store app, released open source by its maintainers
Codebase is roughly half Swift and half Objective-C
Maintainers say they will push Mac App Store updates every two weeks if there is enough interest
Requires a Swift 4 upgrade before the project builds
caveats: Maintainers state they lack time to maintain the app; the project is effectively seeking community maintainers
The project does not currently run until it is upgraded to Swift 4
